tagline_en: Even if memory and world are illusory, lived experience remains the irreducible real. In a mortal life, only revolt, immortal revolt......
tagline_zh: 即使记忆与世界皆可为虚幻，我仍以亲历的感受为不可名状的真实。有限的生命里唯有抗争、抗争....
intro_en: I write music for film and game, make electronic and computer music, pop songs, and build my own instruments from sensors and microcontrollers.
intro_zh: 我为电影和游戏创作配乐，制作电子与计算机音乐、流行歌曲，也用传感器和微控制器搭建自己的乐器。
about_en: I am Tianqi Zhang, a Chinese composer and electronic musician currently based in Bloomington. I am pursuing a double major in Screen Scoring and Computer Music at Indiana University. Deeply fascinated by future technologies and existential philosophy, I explore the tension between human intention and technological autonomy through my work. My music focuses on timbre, texture, and transformation, combining detailed electronic sound design with gestural interaction, emergent processes, and speculative storytelling. Through shifting layers of resonance, noise, spectral movement, and transient detail, I create immersive sonic worlds that move fluidly between order and instability, intimacy and vastness.
about_zh: 我是张天琪，来自中国的作曲家与电子音乐人。出生于河北保定，目前在印第安纳大学攻读影视配乐与计算机音乐双专业。在这个风云变幻的时代，唯有自身感受真实。所以我的作品更多为交互，我相信真实的体验更能带来深刻的记忆，实时的变换方能感受时间的流逝。 我对未来科技与存在主义哲学抱有浓厚兴趣，并通过创作探索人类意图与技术自主性之间的张力。我的音乐以音色、织体与声音形态的转化为核心，将细致的电子声音设计与手势交互、涌现过程和推想性叙事相结合。通过不断变化的共振、噪声、频谱运动与瞬态细节构建出游走于秩序与不稳定、亲密与浩瀚之间的沉浸式声音世界。
